subject: Campaign brief: summer drop, 3 channels
body: Brief: launch the summer collection. Need one Instagram story, one email, one LinkedIn post. Brand kit: primary color #1D4ED8, voice is friendly and confident. No stock photos of people without sunglasses. Deadline 16:00.

subject: reminder: the brief says NO competitor mentions
body: We lost a client last quarter over a competitor comparison. Every asset from this brief must pass the brand check: no competitor names, no superlative claims like 'best in class', no pricing claims.

subject: asset request: hero image caption set
body: Need 5 caption variants for the hero image, tone: friendly but confident, under 120 characters, each with a CTA. One variant must work for TikTok (hashtags, casual), one for LinkedIn (professional).

subject: flag: draft post uses banned word 'revolutionary'
body: The draft subject line says 'revolutionary summer gear'. Our style guide bans 'revolutionary' and 'game-changing' as unverifiable claims. Please regenerate with approved adjectives only.

subject: need 3 Instagram story variants by 13:00
body: Story: behind-the-scenes of the summer shoot. 3 variants: carousel, poll sticker, countdown. Each needs the brand font and color. The poll question must be on-brand (no negative framing).

subject: last campaign: the email with 'free shipping' overperformed 2x
body: Data note: the previous campaign's 'free shipping' email did 2x the baseline. Consider it for this drop. Also: images with people performed better than product-only shots.

subject: content provenance: keep the asset trail for the client audit
body: The client requires a provenance record for every published asset: which brief, which inputs, which edits, which reviewer approved. Store the manifest with each export.

subject: approve the LinkedIn variant before we pay
body: We review every LinkedIn asset before it goes live. Send the variant with the source brief attached so our team can verify it matches the brand kit. Approval within 2 hours.
